raw:
(1) BAKED TEXT — There is no baked-in text in the sense of functional labels. The skin features decorative runic-style glyphs carved into the outer edges of the shield, but these are part of the theme and not readable labels like "PLAY" or "VOLUME".

(2) LAYOUT ADHERENCE — The layout fails adherence because two controls are missing their interactive components. The positions for the volume knob and shuffle toggle are present as empty recesses (a circular hole and a vertical slot, respectively), but the knob and the switch that should be inside them were not generated. All other controls are present and arranged in a sensible, non-overlapping media player layout.

(3) GUIDE-COLOUR RESIDUE — There is no guide-colour residue visible anywhere on the skin. All controls and regions are cleanly painted.

(4) OVERALL QUALITY — EXCELLENT. The skin is a stunning realization of the "goldshield" theme. The textures of the brushed and polished gold, the detailed lion sculpt, the gem inlays, and the runic carvings are all executed to a very high standard. Despite the missing components, the object that was rendered is highly detailed, thematically consistent, and a convincing piece of skeuomorphic design.

VERDICT: FAIL
